entities.summary: Shogo Suzuki (b. 1989-02-04, Odawara) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Odawara and Japan. Known in the fields of japan, composers & musicians, asia.
